   854	`references/qpbt-paper/05_conditionally_linear_functions.tex:366-379`. -/
   855	theorem clDistribution_directSum_eq_prod {K ι : Type*} [Field K]
   856	    [Fintype K] [DecidableEq K] [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
   857	    {m : ℕ} (hm : 1 ≤ m) (V : Fin m → Finset ι)
   858	    (ell : Fin m → ℕ)
   859	    (L R : Fin m → (ι → K) → (ι → K))
   860	    (hDisjoint : ∀ i j, i ≠ j → Disjoint (V i) (V j))
   861	    (hCover : ∀ a, ∃ i, a ∈ V i)
   862	    (hL : ∀ j, IsCondLinearOn K (V j) (ell j) (L j))
   863	    (hR : ∀ j, IsCondLinearOn K (V j) (ell j) (R j))
   864	    (z : (ι → K) × (ι → K)) :
   865	    (clDistribution (condLinearDirectSum V L) (condLinearDirectSum V R)).weight z =
   866	      ∏ j : Fin m, (clDistribution (L j) (R j)).weight
   867	        (coordinateRestriction (V j) z.1, coordinateRestriction (V j) z.2) := by
   868	  classical
   869	  let _sourceIndex : Fin m := ⟨0, hm⟩
   870	  let e : (ι → K) ≃ ∀ j, V j → K :=
   871	    coordinatePartitionEquiv V hDisjoint hCover
   872	  let fiber : (j : Fin m) → Finset (V j → K) := fun j =>
   873	    Finset.univ.filter fun x =>
   874	      (L j (extendRegister (V j) x), R j (extendRegister (V j) x)) =
   875	        (coordinateRestriction (V j) z.1, coordinateRestriction (V j) z.2)
   876	  have hL_support (j : Fin m) (x : ι → K) (a : ι) (ha : a ∉ V j) :
   877	      L j x a = 0 :=
   878	    IsCondLinearOn.apply_eq_zero_of_not_mem (hL j) x ha
   879	  have hR_support (j : Fin m) (x : ι → K) (a : ι) (ha : a ∉ V j) :
   880	      R j x a = 0 :=
   881	    IsCondLinearOn.apply_eq_zero_of_not_mem (hR j) x ha
   882	  have hdirect (x : ι → K) :
   883	      (condLinearDirectSum V L x, condLinearDirectSum V R x) = z ↔
   884	        ∀ j,
   885	          (L j (coordinateRestriction (V j) x),
   886	              R j (coordinateRestriction (V j) x)) =
   887	            (coordinateRestriction (V j) z.1, coordinateRestriction (V j) z.2) := by
   888	    constructor
   889	    · intro h j
   890	      have hleft : condLinearDirectSum V L x = z.1 := congrArg Prod.fst h
   891	      have hright : condLinearDirectSum V R x = z.2 := congrArg Prod.snd h
   892	      have hleft_parts : ∀ i,
   893	          L i (coordinateRestriction (V i) x) = coordinateRestriction (V i) z.1 := by
   894	        apply (sum_eq_iff_coordinateRestriction_eq V hDisjoint hCover
   895	          (fun i => L i (coordinateRestriction (V i) x))
   896	          (fun i a ha => hL_support i _ a ha) z.1).mp
   897	        exact hleft
   898	      have hright_parts : ∀ i,
   899	          R i (coordinateRestriction (V i) x) = coordinateRestriction (V i) z.2 := by
   900	        apply (sum_eq_iff_coordinateRestriction_eq V hDisjoint hCover
   901	          (fun i => R i (coordinateRestriction (V i) x))
   902	          (fun i a ha => hR_support i _ a ha) z.2).mp
   903	        exact hright
   904	      exact Prod.ext (hleft_parts j) (hright_parts j)
   905	    · intro h
   906	      apply Prod.ext
   907	      · apply (sum_eq_iff_coordinateRestriction_eq V hDisjoint hCover
   908	          (fun i => L i (coordinateRestriction (V i) x))
   909	          (fun i a ha => hL_support i _ a ha) z.1).mpr
   910	        exact fun j => congrArg Prod.fst (h j)
   911	      · apply (sum_eq_iff_coordinateRestriction_eq V hDisjoint hCover
   912	          (fun i => R i (coordinateRestriction (V i) x))
   913	          (fun i a ha => hR_support i _ a ha) z.2).mpr
   914	        exact fun j => congrArg Prod.snd (h j)
   915	  have hglobal_card :
   916	      (Finset.univ.filter fun x =>
   917	          (condLinearDirectSum V L x, condLinearDirectSum V R x) = z).card =
   918	        ∏ j, (fiber j).card := by
   919	    calc
   920	      (Finset.univ.filter fun x =>
   921	          (condLinearDirectSum V L x, condLinearDirectSum V R x) = z).card =
   922	          (Finset.univ.filter fun x : ∀ j, V j → K => ∀ j, x j ∈ fiber j).card := by
   923	            apply card_filter_equiv e
   924	            intro x
   925	            rw [hdirect]
   926	            simp only [fiber, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and]
   927	            constructor
   928	            · intro hx j
   929	              simpa only [e, extendRegister_partition_apply V hDisjoint hCover]
   930	                using hx j
   931	            · intro hx j
   932	              simpa only [e, extendRegister_partition_apply V hDisjoint hCover]
   933	                using hx j
   934	      _ = (Fintype.piFinset fiber).card := by
   935	            congr 1
   936	            ext x
   937	            simp
   938	      _ = ∏ j, (fiber j).card := Fintype.card_piFinset fiber
   939	  have hcomponent_card (j : Fin m) :
   940	      (Finset.univ.filter fun x =>
   941	          (L j x, R j x) =
   942	            (coordinateRestriction (V j) z.1, coordinateRestriction (V j) z.2)).card =
   943	        (fiber j).card *
   944	          ∏ i : {i // i ≠ j}, Fintype.card (V i.1 → K) := by
   945	    calc
   946	      (Finset.univ.filter fun x =>
   947	          (L j x, R j x) =
   948	            (coordinateRestriction (V j) z.1, coordinateRestriction (V j) z.2)).card =
   949	          (Finset.univ.filter fun x : ∀ i, V i → K => x j ∈ fiber j).card := by
   950	            apply card_filter_equiv e
   951	            intro x
   952	            simp only [fiber, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and]
   953	            rw [extendRegister_partition_apply V hDisjoint hCover]
   954	            rw [IsCondLinearOn.apply_coordinateRestriction (hL j) x]
   955	            rw [IsCondLinearOn.apply_coordinateRestriction (hR j) x]
   956	      _ = (fiber j).card *
   957	          ∏ i : {i // i ≠ j}, Fintype.card (V i.1 → K) :=
   958	        card_filter_pi_apply_mem (fun i => V i → K) j (fiber j)
   959	  have hcard_seed : Fintype.card (ι → K) = ∏ j, Fintype.card (V j → K) := by
   960	    rw [Fintype.card_congr e, Fintype.card_pi]
   961	  have hcomponent_weight (j : Fin m) :
   962	      (clDistribution (L j) (R j)).weight
   963	          (coordinateRestriction (V j) z.1, coordinateRestriction (V j) z.2) =
   964	        ((fiber j).card : Error) / Fintype.card (V j → K) := by
   965	    rw [clDistribution_weight_eq_card_filter_div, hcomponent_card, hcard_seed]
   966	    rw [Fintype.prod_eq_mul_prod_subtype_ne _ j]
   967	    push_cast
   968	    have hcardj : (Fintype.card (V j → K) : Error) ≠ 0 := by positivity
   969	    have hcard_rest :
   970	        (∏ i : {i // i ≠ j}, (Fintype.card (V i.1 → K) : Error)) ≠ 0 := by
   971	      positivity
   972	    field_simp
   973	  rw [clDistribution_weight_eq_card_filter_div, hglobal_card, hcard_seed]
   974	  simp_rw [hcomponent_weight]
   975	  rw [Finset.prod_div_distrib]
   976	  push_cast
   977	  rfl
   978	
   979	end MIPStarRE.QPBT

     3	/-! # Structure and direct sums of conditionally linear functions
     4	
     5	This module records the prefix decomposition of a conditionally linear map and
     6	the behavior of such maps and their shared-seed distributions under finite
     7	coordinate direct sums.
     8	
     9	## References
    10	
    11	The source results are `lem:cl-kth`, `lem:cl-func-prod`, and
    12	`lem:cl-dist-prod` in `blueprint/src/chapter/ch12_qpbt_games.tex:520-587`, with
    13	paper origin
    14	`references/qpbt-paper/05_conditionally_linear_functions.tex:150-379`.
    15	-/
    16	
    17	open scoped BigOperators
    18	
    19	namespace MIPStarRE.QPBT
    20	
    21	open MIPStarRE.LDT
    22	
    23	/-- The value of the strict-prefix marginal preceding `k`. This is a
    24	formalization-only auxiliary for `lem:cl-kth`, blueprint
    25	`ch12_qpbt_games.tex:520-540`, paper
    26	`references/qpbt-paper/05_conditionally_linear_functions.tex:150-178`. -/
    27	def clPrefix {K ι : Type*} [Zero K] {ell : ℕ}
    28	    (marginal : Fin ell → (ι → K) → (ι → K)) (k : Fin ell)
    29	    (x : ι → K) : ι → K :=
    30	  if _hk : k.val = 0 then 0
    31	  else marginal ⟨k.val - 1, lt_of_le_of_lt (Nat.sub_le _ _) k.isLt⟩ x
    32	
    33	/-- Prefix-indexed decomposition data from `lem:cl-kth`. Factor spaces are
    34	represented by their coordinate sets, matching the register-subspace encoding
    35	used by `IsCondLinearOn`. Blueprint `ch12_qpbt_games.tex:520-540`, paper
    36	`references/qpbt-paper/05_conditionally_linear_functions.tex:150-178`. -/
    37	structure CLData (K ι : Type*) [Field K] [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    38	    (ell : ℕ) (L : (ι → K) → (ι → K)) where
    39	  /-- The marginal `L_{≤k}`. -/
    40	  marginal : Fin ell → (ι → K) → (ι → K)
    41	  /-- The factor register selected by a prefix value. -/
    42	  factor : Fin ell → (ι → K) → Finset ι
    43	  /-- The linear map selected by a prefix value. -/
    44	  linear : Fin ell → (ι → K) → ((ι → K) →ₗ[K] (ι → K))
    45	  /-- Each marginal has the corresponding conditionally linear level. -/
    46	  marginal_cl : ∀ k, IsCondLinearOn K Finset.univ (k.val + 1) (marginal k)
    47	  /-- The selected factor registers are pairwise disjoint. -/
    48	  factor_disjoint : ∀ x i j, i ≠ j →
    49	    Disjoint (factor i (clPrefix marginal i x)) (factor j (clPrefix marginal j x))
    50	  /-- The selected factor registers cover all coordinates. -/
    51	  factor_cover : ∀ x a, ∃ i, a ∈ factor i (clPrefix marginal i x)
    52	  /-- Each selected linear map is supported on its factor register. -/
    53	  linear_supported : ∀ k u x a, a ∉ factor k u → linear k u x a = 0
    54	  /-- Each marginal is the sum of the preceding selected linear pieces. -/
    55	  sum_formula : ∀ k x, marginal k x =
    56	    ∑ i : Fin ell, if i.val ≤ k.val then
    57	      linear i (clPrefix marginal i x)
    58	        (coordinateRestriction (factor i (clPrefix marginal i x)) x) else 0
    59	  /-- The final marginal is the original function. -/
    60	  top : ∀ h : 0 < ell,
    61	    marginal ⟨ell - 1, Nat.sub_lt h (by decide)⟩ = L
    62	
    63	/-- A map is `ell`-level conditionally linear exactly when it admits the
    64	prefix decomposition of `lem:cl-kth`; blueprint `ch12_qpbt_games.tex:520-540`,
    65	paper `references/qpbt-paper/05_conditionally_linear_functions.tex:150-262`. -/
    66	theorem isCondLinear_iff_nonempty_clData {K ι : Type*} [Field K]
    67	    [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] {ell : ℕ} (hEll : 1 ≤ ell)
    68	    (L : (ι → K) → (ι → K)) :
    69	    IsCondLinear ell L ↔ Nonempty (CLData K ι ell L) := by
    70	  sorry
    71	
    72	/-- Coordinate direct sum of maps supported on a finite register partition.
    73	This is a formalization-only auxiliary for `lem:cl-func-prod`, blueprint
    74	`ch12_qpbt_games.tex:565-576`, paper
    75	`references/qpbt-paper/05_conditionally_linear_functions.tex:315-364`. -/
    76	def condLinearDirectSum {K ι : Type*} [Field K] [DecidableEq ι] {m : ℕ}
    77	    (V : Fin m → Finset ι) (L : Fin m → (ι → K) → (ι → K))
    78	    (x : ι → K) : ι → K :=
    79	  ∑ j : Fin m, L j (coordinateRestriction (V j) x)
    80	
    81	/-- Maximum of the levels in a finite direct sum. This formalization-only
    82	auxiliary uses `0` for the empty family; `lem:cl-func-prod` separately assumes
    83	the source boundary `m ≥ 1`. -/
    84	def directSumLevel {m : ℕ} (ell : Fin m → ℕ) : ℕ :=
    85	  Finset.univ.sup ell
    86	
    87	/-- Direct sums over a register partition preserve conditional linearity. The
    88	level-zero case is included explicitly, as required by the local correction to
    89	`lem:cl-func-prod`; blueprint `ch12_qpbt_games.tex:565-576`, paper
    90	`references/qpbt-paper/05_conditionally_linear_functions.tex:315-364`. -/
    91	theorem IsCondLinear.directSum {K ι : Type*} [Field K]
    92	    [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] {m : ℕ} (hm : 1 ≤ m)
    93	    (V : Fin m → Finset ι) (ell : Fin m → ℕ)
    94	    (L : Fin m → (ι → K) → (ι → K))
    95	    (hDisjoint : ∀ i j, i ≠ j → Disjoint (V i) (V j))
    96	    (hCover : ∀ a, ∃ i, a ∈ V i)
    97	    (hL : ∀ j, IsCondLinearOn K (V j) (ell j) (L j)) :
    98	    IsCondLinear (directSumLevel ell) (condLinearDirectSum V L) := by
    99	  sorry
   100	
   101	/-- The CL distribution of coordinate direct sums factors into the component
   102	CL distributions. The equality is stated pointwise on weights, which is the
   103	finite-distribution meaning of the product in `lem:cl-dist-prod`; blueprint
   104	`ch12_qpbt_games.tex:582-587`, paper
   105	`references/qpbt-paper/05_conditionally_linear_functions.tex:366-379`. -/
   106	theorem clDistribution_directSum_eq_prod {K ι : Type*} [Field K]
   107	    [Fintype K] [DecidableEq K] [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
   108	    {m : ℕ} (hm : 1 ≤ m) (V : Fin m → Finset ι)
   109	    (ell : Fin m → ℕ)
   110	    (L R : Fin m → (ι → K) → (ι → K))
   111	    (hDisjoint : ∀ i j, i ≠ j → Disjoint (V i) (V j))
   112	    (hCover : ∀ a, ∃ i, a ∈ V i)
   113	    (hL : ∀ j, IsCondLinearOn K (V j) (ell j) (L j))
   114	    (hR : ∀ j, IsCondLinearOn K (V j) (ell j) (R j))
   115	    (z : (ι → K) × (ι → K)) :
   116	    (clDistribution (condLinearDirectSum V L) (condLinearDirectSum V R)).weight z =
   117	      ∏ j : Fin m, (clDistribution (L j) (R j)).weight
   118	        (coordinateRestriction (V j) z.1, coordinateRestriction (V j) z.2) := by
   119	  sorry
   120	
   121	end MIPStarRE.QPBT

     3	/-!
     4	# Conditionally linear functions and graph distributions
     5	
     6	The question distributions in the Pauli basis test are generated by a finite
     7	graph of types and a shared seed, with each type applying a conditionally linear
     8	map to that seed.  The inductive predicate below records the level structure
     9	needed by later formalization stages.
    10	
    11	## References
    12	
    13	The source-facing nodes are `def:cl-func`, `def:cl-dist`, `lem:cl-concat`, and
    14	`def:graph-distribution` in `blueprint/src/chapter/ch12_qpbt_games.tex:441-535`.
    15	The paper origin is `references/qpbt-paper/05_conditionally_linear_functions.tex:35-57`
    16	and `references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:964-1010`.
    17	-/
    18	
    19	open scoped BigOperators
    20	
    21	namespace MIPStarRE.QPBT
    22	
    23	open MIPStarRE.LDT
    24	
    25	variable {K ι : Type*} [Field K] [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    26	
    27	/--
    28	The source definition is recursive in the residual map.  A direct inductive
    29	predicate with that recursive occurrence under a dependent finite-set index is
    30	rejected by Lean's strict-positivity checker.  We therefore expose the same
    31	public predicate through a positive syntax tree (`CondLinearTerm`), together
    32	with its support invariant and evaluation function.  This is a representation
    33	deviation forced by Lean, not an additional mathematical hypothesis.  It encodes
    34	`def:cl-func`, blueprint `blueprint/src/chapter/ch12_qpbt_games.tex:441-463`,

#!/usr/bin/env python3
r"""Blueprint ``\leanok`` axiom-closure checker.

This script audits the blueprint chapters against the Lean codebase.
For each unique declaration referenced by ``\lean{...}`` in
``blueprint/src/chapter/*.tex`` it:

* checks that the declaration exists in the Lean source tree;
* if any blueprint entry for that declaration carries ``\leanok`` on the
  statement or proof, runs ``#print axioms`` and fails on any transitive
  dependency on ``sorryAx``;
* optionally warns when a blueprint declaration is sorry-free in Lean but
  lacks any ``\leanok`` tag (enable ``--warn-missing-leanok``).

The checker imports only the Lean modules that define the referenced
blueprint declarations, rather than importing the top-level ``MIPStarRE``
barrel. This keeps the rebuild scope small and avoids stale-barrel issues.

Use ``--skip-axiom-check`` for a fast parse-only smoke test.
Use ``--ci`` to exit with status 1 when any ``\leanok`` declaration fails the
axiom audit.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import os
import re
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile
from collections import defaultdict
from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from pathlib import Path

from blueprint_lean_sync import BlueprintEntry, LeanDecl, collect_blueprint_entries, collect_lean_decls


_ANSI_RE = re.compile(r"\x1b\[[0-9;]*[A-Za-z]")


@dataclass
class DeclAxiomInfo:
    """Axiom-check result for one Lean declaration."""

    exists: bool
    axioms: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)
    raw: str = ""
    parse_error: bool = False
    harness_error: str | None = None

    @property
    def sorry(self) -> bool:
        return any(a == "sorryAx" or a.startswith("sorryAx.") for a in self.axioms)


@dataclass
class DeclFailure:
    """A failing blueprint declaration tagged with ``\\leanok``.

    ``placement`` records the strongest ``\\leanok`` placement observed for
    the declaration across all of its blueprint entries: ``"proof"``,
    ``"statement"``, or ``"none"``. Failures only arise from proof-level
    claims; statement-level-only decls produce warnings instead.
    """

    decl: str
    entries: list[BlueprintEntry]
    reason: str
    info: DeclAxiomInfo | None = None
    placement: str = "none"


@dataclass
class DeclWarning:
    """A non-fatal blueprint/Lean discrepancy.

    ``placement`` mirrors :class:`DeclFailure` so callers can tell a
    statement-level-only sorry warning apart from a missing-tag warning.
    """

    decl: str
    entries: list[BlueprintEntry]
    reason: str
    info: DeclAxiomInfo | None = None
    placement: str = "none"


@dataclass
class AuditResult:
    """Full blueprint-axiom audit report."""

    entries: list[BlueprintEntry]
    pass_count: int
    failures: list[DeclFailure]
    warnings: list[DeclWarning]

    @property
    def ok(self) -> bool:
        return not self.failures


def _strip_ansi(s: str) -> str:
    return _ANSI_RE.sub("", s)


def _entry_has_leanok(entry: BlueprintEntry) -> bool:
    return entry.has_leanok or entry.proof_has_leanok


def _group_entries_by_decl(entries: list[BlueprintEntry]) -> dict[str, list[BlueprintEntry]]:
    grouped: dict[str, list[BlueprintEntry]] = {}
    for entry in entries:
        grouped.setdefault(entry.lean_decl, []).append(entry)
    return grouped


def _decl_has_any_leanok(entries: list[BlueprintEntry]) -> bool:
    return any(_entry_has_leanok(entry) for entry in entries)


def _decl_leanok_placement(entries: list[BlueprintEntry]) -> str:
    """Classify a declaration's strongest ``\\leanok`` claim across ``entries``.

    Following ``docs/blueprint_style_guide.md``:

    * ``proof`` — at least one entry carries proof-level ``\\leanok``. This
      is the only placement that claims the Lean proof is complete, so the
      axiom-closure check *must* fail on ``sorryAx`` for these decls.
    * ``statement`` — at least one entry carries statement-level
      ``\\leanok`` but none carries proof-level. The Lean declaration
      exists and its statement matches; the proof is not claimed complete,
      so a ``sorryAx`` finding is reported as a warning rather than a
      hard error.
    * ``none`` — no ``\\leanok`` anywhere.
    """
    has_proof = any(entry.proof_has_leanok for entry in entries)
    if has_proof:
        return "proof"
    has_statement = any(entry.has_leanok for entry in entries)
    if has_statement:
        return "statement"
    return "none"


def module_name_from_decl(decl: LeanDecl) -> str:
    """Turn ``MIPStarRE/Foo/Bar.lean`` into ``MIPStarRE.Foo.Bar``."""
    return ".".join(Path(decl.file).with_suffix("").parts)


def group_decls_by_module(
    decls: list[str],
    lean_decls: dict[str, LeanDecl],
) -> dict[str, list[str]]:
    grouped: dict[str, list[str]] = defaultdict(list)
    for decl in decls:
        if decl not in lean_decls:
            continue
        grouped[module_name_from_decl(lean_decls[decl])].append(decl)
    return dict(sorted(grouped.items()))

    output: str,
    decls: list[str],

    Returns ``None`` when the harness failed before any declaration-specific

    """
